svg.title: Прокатывание спины на ролле — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Thoracic back foam rolling. True side view. Athlete face up with feet flat, knees bent, hips slightly lifted, hands cradling head. One textured horizontal foam cylinder UNDER upper back, its circular end visible and bottom on ground. LEFT cylinder contacts lower thoracic back. RIGHT same roller contacts higher thoracic back after knees bend a little more to shift body toward feet. Keep pelvis and back supported, do not roll on neck or low back. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
